items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That could have been Cedric, no, huh? Not Gene Cedric from St. Louis, not that. [INTERVIEWEE] He was a little bride from Slim. He's about the size of a ball stick. That's a little ball stick. Very nice fella. Very nice fella.
